translations.web: “ ‘They will know that I am Yahweh when I disperse them among the nations, and scatter them through the countries.
translations.bsb: And they will know that I am the LORD, when I disperse them among the nations and scatter them throughout the countries.
translations.kjv: And they shall know that I am the LORD, when I shall scatter them among the nations, and disperse them in the countries.
translations.asv: And they shall know that I am Jehovah, when I shall disperse them among the nations, and scatter them through the countries.
